name: Baked Ratatouille with White Beans
ingredients: 1 small eggplant, 1 zucchini and 2 bell peppers, diced
1 tsp dried thyme and 1 tsp dried basil
steps: Toss the eggplant, zucchini, peppers and onion with the oil, garlic, herbs and seasoning.
Mix with the tomatoes, tomato paste and white beans in a baking dish.
Cover with foil and bake for 30 minutes; uncover and bake for 15 minutes more, stirring once.
note: Adding white beans turns a vegetable side dish into a main meal with extra fibre.
